title: Decide chat-filenode crate placement
description: Decision bead: JMAP-v9py.16 planned separate jmap-chat-filenode-* crates but the code landed in chat-* crates. Decide and update the epic.
acceptance_criteria: Tests use an independent oracle: each assertion cites and quotes the governing draft sentence (file + line) or uses RFC/draft-published vectors; the code under test is never its own oracle. Decision recorded; epic text updated.
notes: DECIDED by Mark 2026-10-20: binding crate. New crate-jmap-chat-filenode-server (depends on jmap-chat-server + jmap-filenode-server) holds the cross-layer server rules (Space-role -> FilesRights authorizer, root validation, quota/auto-create, tree destroy with grace, attachment-by-filenodeId checks). Fields on chat objects stay in jmap-chat-types (Attachment.filenodeId etc., already landed); client methods stay in jmap-chat-client. Generic hooks needed in filenode-server/chat-server (authorizer hook, cascade callbacks) stay in those crates. Same pattern applies to chat-calendars (v9py.17) and chat-tasks (v9py.18): binding *-server crates, chat-object fields in chat-types.
close_reason: Decided by Mark 2026-10-20; decision recorded in notes
